battleTraits.name: Target of Vengeance
battleTraits.declare: If there is no enemy quarry on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: The target is the quarry for the rest of the battle.
battleTraits.timingText: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round

battleTraits.name: Song of the Hunt
battleTraits.effect: You gain 1 chord each time an enemy quarry is destroyed. Cumulative effects: 1 chord – add 1 to run and charge rolls for friendly units within 9" of the quarry. 2 chords – also add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units' attacks within 9" of the quarry. 3+ chords – also add 1 to wound rolls for friendly units' attacks within 9" of the quarry.

battleTraits.name: Airborne Cohesion
battleTraits.effect: Friendly units have a coherency range of 2".

regimentAbilities.name: Leaves on the Wind
regimentAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to be the target.
regimentAbilities.effect: The target can immediately use the Retreat ability as if it were your movement phase, and no mortal damage is inflicted on it if it does so.
regimentAbilities.timingText: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn

regimentAbilities.name: Lifebringers
regimentAbilities.timingText: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

enhancements.name: Head of the Hunt
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general's melee weapons while the enemy quarry is within 9" of and visible to them.

enhancements.name: Zephyrkin
enhancements.effect: If your general charged this turn, they can move up to 2D6" after their Fight ability has been resolved. They cannot end that move in combat.
enhancements.timingText: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for your general

enhancements.name: Bold Spirit
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for friendly units' combat attacks while they are within your general's combat range.
enhancements.timingText: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase

enhancements.name: Cunning Pursuer
enhancements.effect: While your general is in combat, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly units wholly within 12" of them. Add 2 instead while your general is in combat with the quarry.

abilities.name: Heartwood Hunting Horn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, when determining which 'Song of the Hunt' effects apply to the target, you count as having 1 additional chord.

abilities.name: Zephyrspites
abilities.effect: After the declared Shoot ability has been resolved, this unit can move up to D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
abilities.timingText: Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit

abilities.name: Spiterider Charge
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. Add 1 to the roll if the target is the enemy quarry. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Deafening Drone
abilities.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Control characteristic, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
